# ciview

> Bun OpenTUI GitLab CI cockpit. Spec-first corpus in doc/arch; implementation in src/ciview.

spec-first: doc/arch is the source of truth — run `speckit status` then `speckit next` and read the spec before writing any code.

## Project

Interactive CI board: openProject on Enter; stage columns; job log drawer. Auth glab. Exit code 0 1 2. Speckit --json for agents.

## Architecture

Layers: auth cli config git gitlab nav poll projects runtime state ui util under `src/ciview/`.

Product exit code: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 auth. Speckit supports --json on management commands.
Config families: project git guard context dedupe adr stats semantic gitlab hygiene compliance workflow privacy.


## Conventions

Guard enforce. Silent poll. Feature 001+002 implemented. Angular commits.
